summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing an 18 September 2026 London announcement of open-market purchases of its own ordinary shares, executed by UBS AG, London Branch under an existing buyback programme instructed 16 February 2026. Over 14–15 September 2026, 1,984,195 ordinary shares were repurchased across LSE, CHIX and BATE at a volume-weighted average price of roughly 680p, with a high of 690p and low of 674.60p. Repurchased shares will be cancelled; treasury stock stands at 178,266,406 and shares in issue at 7,944,726,137. Watch execution pace and any programme expansion or special dividend at results.
